The glove controller uses hand gestures to send signals to the robot arm to control it, comprised of 4 flex sensors, gyroscope sensor (MPU6050), Arduino Nano and a Bluetooth module (HC-05 / master).Through research and analysis many tests were performed to calibrate the different components so that the finished assembled prototype could work seamlessly while performing tasks.

articleTitle: DFNet: Dual Feature Network for Point Cloud Registration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In point cloud registration, global and local features collectively constitute a comprehensive description of point cloud data. Previous methods for registration mostly relied on a single kind of features, and the correspondence matching based methods require inputs with distinctive local structures, so the quality of feature extraction directly impacts the accuracy of the registration results. The global feature-based methods can obtain global geometric information of the inputs, but the lack of local information can easily overlook the negative effect of non-overlapping points. In this paper, we present DFNet, an iterative network based on dual feature extraction for partial-to-partial point cloud registration. We use a dual branch structure to individually extract both global and local features, fully utilizing the geometric characteristics of the point cloud. Experiments indicate that our method outperforms other registration approaches in terms of accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Secure Distributed Estimation Based on Density Peak in Multi-Task Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Distributed multi-task parameter estimation has attracted considerable attention in recent years, finding applications across diverse domains. However, in open external environments, wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are particularly vulnerable to malicious attacks, which can compromise sensor data and degrade overall network performance. To achieve secure estimation, we propose a multi-task diffusion least mean square with density peak (MDLMS-DP) algorithm. This algorithm utilizes density peak nodes to establish adaptive thresholds, effectively identifying compromised nodes. Furthermore, we introduce an innovative data fusion strategy to improve estimation accuracy and robustness. Simulation results validate that the proposed algorithm maintains robust performance even in adversarial networks.

articleTitle: Improved method based on complex background YOLOv8 optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Establishing a lightweight yet high-precision object detection algorithm is essential for accurately assessing the helmet-wearing status of workers in complex industrial environments. Helmet detection poses significant challenges due to several factors, including small target size, intricate backgrounds, and the need to balance model compactness with detection accuracy. In this article, we propose an improved method based on the YOLOv8 model. Our approach enhances the model’s capability to detect small targets within complex settings. Additionally, we introduce a novel module that integrates Depthwise Convolution (DWConv) with the RepVGG network structure into the backbone feature extraction network. This integration aims to reduce model complexity while improving accuracy. To further enhance helmet detection performance, we incorporated a C2fDFC attention mechanism module into the feature extraction network. This addition reduces both parameter count and computational load, ultimately leading to superior helmet detection outcomes. We used the Hard Hat Workers Object Detection Dataset released by Roboflow, which is a dataset of hard hats in complex situations, to verify our research method. Our proposed model achieved an optimal mean Average Precision at IoU 0.50 (mAP50) of 66.1 %. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in achieving lightweight deployment alongside high-precision helmet detection.

articleTitle: Research on flange edge detection method based on reprojection transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Flanges are an important component in the industry, used for pipe connections and equipment assembly. Accurate edge detection is key to flange positioning and pose estimation. Traditional methods like Canny and Sobel are effective under ideal conditions, but they are difficult with complex backgrounds and noise. In this study, we propose a method to locate the projection plane by using the geometric constraints of bolt holes, and optimize the edge of the extracted flange based on the projection plane. Finally, the ellipse fitting of the extracted flange edge is carried out, and the ellipse fitting result is used to replace the flange edge, which ensures the continuity and accuracy of the extracted edge and realizes the extraction of the flange edge. Experimental results show that the proposed method has a significant effect on the edge discontinuity caused by noise and occlusion, and significantly improves the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Ensemble learning lithology prediction based on fast non-dominated sorting algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Lithology identification plays a key role in reservoir characterization tasks of oil and gas exploration and engineering. Traditional lithology identification relies on professional knowledge and manual experience, which is laborintensive, time-consuming and affected by subjectivityand inconsistency of expert experience. A variety of supervised learning methods such as naive Bayes and support vector machine have been applied, but it is difficult to directly compare the differences between data sets and lithology classification schemes. In this study, an integrated learning model based on support vector machine, random forest, multi-layer perceptron and XGBoost is constructed. The fast non-dominated sorting optimization algorithm is used to optimize the hyper-parameters of the meta-classifier in the integrated learning model. Through experiments, the model is tested on specific lithology data samples, and the performance of the model is evaluated by indicators such as accuracy and recall rate. The experimental results show that the ensemble learning model optimized by hyperparameters has a significant improvement in the accuracy of lithology classification, which effectively overcomes the shortcomings of traditional methods, provides a more reliable and efficient solution for lithology identification, and helps to promote the development of lithology identification technology in the field of oil and gas exploration and engineering.

articleTitle: Design of Sliding Mode Extended State Observer for Active disturbance rejection control of Air Intake System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The air intake control system is a key part of a type of propulsion system test bed. However, the existence of disturbances and random measurement noise in the control system, directly affect the reliability of the engine transition state test results. In this paper, a novel sliding mode extended state observer is designed to improve the anti-disturbance performance of the intake pressure control system. First, a sliding-mode convergence law is designed to improve the convergence speed and accuracy of the system state, and then a sliding mode surface is designed to reduce tracking error. Based on the designed sliding-mode convergence law and sliding mode surface, a nonlinear convergence function is designed to modify the structure of traditional extended state observer, improving tracking accuracy and speed. Simulation experiment results show that the proposed sliding mode extended state observer reduces the overshoot by $\mathbf{3 2. 7 \%}$ when tracking the intake pressure and 48.9% when tracking the intake temperature, indicating its effective anti-disturbance performance while ignoring the temperature feedback delay.

articleTitle: An Improved RRT Algorithm for Path Planning of Unmanned Spraying Device
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In the hilly fruit orchards of Sichuan, fruit trees are planted in evenly spaced straight rows, dividing the workspace into long, narrow spaces. In these areas, the convergence efficiency of the Rapidly Exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm is low, resulting in discontinuous path planning. To address these issues, an improved RRT algorithm is proposed by this paper. For reducing the randomness and enhancing convergence speed, the watershed algorithm is used to extract guiding nodes from the grid map. Additionally, in order to meet dynamic constraints of practical applications, angle constraints and path smoothing algorithms are incorporated. The experimental results indicate that, compared with other algorithms, the proposed method reduces the time consumption by ${8 8. 3 5 \%}, {8 5. 5 6 \%}, 55.32 \%$ and ${9 5. 4 4 \%}$, and the number of iterations by ${9 0. 9 4 \%} {9} {9 0. 3 9 \%}, {8 9. 1 4 \%}$ and 91.68%, respectively. These results show the significant advantages of the proposed algorithm in improving the planning speed and the path quality.

articleTitle: Construction of the full life cycle data management model for complex aerospace products based on digital twins
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Complex aerospace products such as satellites, missiles, and rockets have features like high complexity, strong dynamics, and frequent design changes during the design and manufacturing processes. Thus, data management throughout full life cycle of complex aerospace products is a challenge. However, the emergence of the concept of digital twins offers a new management model for full life cycle data management of complex aerospace products. To achieve data management at all stage from design to manufacturing of complex aerospace products, this paper proposes full life cycle data management method for complex aerospace products based on digital twins. Firstly, the evolution process of full life cycle data of complex aerospace products is analyzed from the perspective of the concept of digital twins. Based on this, a full life cycle data management model for complex aerospace products based on digital twins is constructed, and key technologies such as the workflow-based business process management system for the design-process-manufacturing of complex aerospace products and the construction of the digital twin model for the production quality management of complex aerospace products are broken through. On this basic, full life cycle data management system for complex aerospace products based on digital twins is developed, verifying the effectiveness of this method. Finally, the work of this paper is summarized, and the future research works is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Evaluation Method of Interpretability Based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Since deep learning models are often regarded as “black box models” and their decision-making process lacks transparency, this paper introduces a new quantitative evaluation framework for the interpretability of deep learning models, aiming to improve the interpretability of models. The framework is based on YOLOv8 and MobileSAM, and introduces two quantitative evaluation indicators: $\mathrm{N}-\mathrm{IOU}$ and N -Recall. The $\mathrm{N}-\mathrm{IOU}$ index extends the traditional concept of IOU by measuring the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the model explanation; The $\mathbf{N}$-Recall metric focuses on the recall of the model when identifying positive samples, especially the performance of difficult samples. Experiments show that the dataset selected using these indicators is similar to the original dataset in terms of model loss and classification accuracy, while the randomly selected dataset has an accuracy difference of $1.4-1.6 \%$. In addition, this study also provides a method for automating the generation of structured annotated data, which reduces the cost and time of data preparation, and is of great significance for the construction and maintenance of large-scale image datasets.

articleTitle: A Self-organized Coverage Algorithm for UAV Swarms based on Color Information Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a self-organized coverage method for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm aimed at multi-area coverage. The proposed method attempts to take the color light emitted from the UVA as an important state information. The virtual forces and the color state are incorporated to develop the self-organized coverage algorithm, so that the communication dependency among UAV swarm has been weakened. Simulation experiments show that under the condition of weak communication, the algorithm effectively achieves coverage of multiple areas. Moreover, when part of UAVs in the swarm are damaged or fails, the swarm based on the proposed algorithm can achieve self-organized recovery and continue to complete the task.

articleTitle: Task Offloading Optimization in Vehicular Edge Computing with Meta-Policy Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication and Internet technology, the Internet of Vehicle (IoV) is becoming a key development direction in the future transportation field. Vehicle applications are generating more and more data. Offloading computational tasks to traditional cloud platforms often results in high task latency. To address these challenges, Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) has become a promising solution, enabling the execution of complex computational tasks on edge servers deployed within roadside units (RSUs). By reducing data transmission delays and providing localized computing capabilities, VEC significantly enhances the performance of IoV systems. In this paper, we propose an intelligent task offloading algorithm based on a meta-reinforcement learning framework. Our approach models vehicle applications as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), representing intricate dependencies among computational tasks. Using recurrent neural networks (RNNs), our algorithm learns optimized offloading strategies through training, dynamically adapting to varying task demands and network conditions. The experimental results indicate that the vehicle task offloading strategy obtained using this method can achieve low energy consumption while ensuring low latency. And this method leverages the computational capabilities of edge servers to enable efficient resource allocation and optimized scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Gearbox Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Multisensor Fusion and Maximum Classifier Discrepancy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Addressing the challenges posed by domain distribution differences and the complexities of features across various domains in gearbox fault diagnosis under variable operating conditions, this paper presents a fault diagnosis method based on multisensor fusion (MSF) and maximum classifier discrepancy (MCD). Initially, the continuous wavelet transform (CWT) is employed to convert the gearbox multisensor signals into grayscale images. The resulting grayscale maps are then fused to serve as input for the fault diagnosis model. An improved DenseNet, incorporating the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), is utilized as the feature extractor for the fault diagnosis model. To tackle the issue of feature distribution discrepancies under different operating conditions and the challenges associated with aligning features from distinct domains, MCD is applied to align the target domain features more closely with those from the source domain. Experimental results demonstrate that the model proposed in this study effectively diagnoses gearbox faults under variable operating conditions.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Implicit 3D Reconstruction Based on Adaptive Threshold Optimal Transport
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: To achieve high precision reconstruction of complex point cloud data, this paper presents a novel method based on an adaptive threshold. Firstly, a pre trained neural network is used to initially segment the point cloud, and an adaptive threshold is introduced into the discrete optimal transport to effectively detect feature regions such as edges and corners based on local geometric information. Subsequently, a zero level set smoothing loss function and a normal alignment loss function are introduced into the implicit neural network to optimize the feature region and the smooth region respectively. Finally, the optimized point cloud is reconstructed through the Marching Cubes algorithm. Experimental results show that compared with DeepSDF and Occupancy Networks, the accuracy of the proposed method on the corresponding data sets is improved by 3.33% and 1.2% respectively.

articleTitle: Performance Review on LLM for solving leetcode problems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive performance evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) in solving programming challenges from Leetcode, a widely used platform for algorithm practice and technical interviews. We began by crawling the Leetcode website to collect a diverse set of problems encompassing various difficulty levels and topics. Using this dataset, we generated solutions with multiple LLMs, including GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo (ChatGPT-turbo). The generated solutions were systematically evaluated for correctness and efficiency. We employed the pass@k metric to assess the success rates within a given number of attempts and analyzed the runtime performance of the solutions. Our results highlight the strengths and limitations of current LLMs [1] in code generation and problem-solving tasks, providing insights into their potential applications and areas for improvement in automated programming assistance.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Claw Control Method for UAV with Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This paper investigates a mechanical claw control method, wherein an applicable mechanical claw includes a finger and a micromotion position compensation mechanism that drives the finger to move along the axial direction of the mechanical claw, and the steps of the control method include obtaining task information, calculating a desired opening and closing degree of the finger according to the task information; issuing a preopening command to preopen the finger; calculating a projection deviation of the fingertip in the axial direction of the mechanical claw according to the desired opening and closing degree of the finger; and controlling a micromotion The position compensation mechanism adjusts the position of the finger in the axial direction of the mechanical claw. Taking fully into account the influence of the finger movement path as an arc on the offset of the gripping point, the offset can be compensated so that the actual position of the workpiece to be gripped is consistent with the preset position, avoiding pressing on the part of the workpiece that can not withstand the pressure, and gripping the workpiece with the accurate degree of opening and closing to avoid knocking out the workpiece.

articleTitle: Lightweight Ship Object Detection Algorithm in SAR Images based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Due to the small size of detection of targets and the complexity of the background in SAR images, the model has problems such as excessively complex models and low detection accuracy. Therefore, this paper presents the YOLOv8-AREB algorithm. This refined algorithm commences by eliminating the layer dedicated to large target detection from SAR imagery, streamlining the network architecture. In the main network, it uses RepConv and EMA attention mechanism to improve detection accuracy by multi-branch reparameterization and aggregation of cross-spatial dimension information. Additionally, in feature extraction stage, it incorporates BoTnet backbone to improve effectiveness of feature extraction and while enhancing overall model performance. During training, the Focal_EIoU loss is employed to enhance target detection accuracy and improve the ability to generalize. Experiments illustrate that the YOLOv8-AREB algorithm offers advantages such as high detection accuracy, low computational complexity, and minimal parameter requirements.

articleTitle: Invisible Character-Based Steganography in Social Network Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of social networks, the use of human behavior to achieve information hiding has become a hot spot in current steganography research. In this paper, we propose a social network behavioral steganography based on invisible characters. The method realizes information transmission by embedding invisible characters in the common friend dynamics of the sender and the receiver, and using the time interval of social behaviors. The receiver, in turn, extracts the secret information by periodically obtaining information about the social behaviors of the mutual friends. Experimental results show that the method has significant advantages in improving the capacity and security of message delivery, and can effectively resist brute-force and impersonation attacks while keeping the communication covert.

articleTitle: Tool wear state recognition method based on improved ResNet and feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The tool is the executing part of the machine tool processing, and its wear state directly affects the production efficiency and product quality. This paper proposes a tool wear state recognition method based on improved ResNet and feature fusion. This method first extracts features from various fields from triaxial vibration signals, temperature signals and power signals, and uses PCA technology to fuse the features. In order to better process the feature fusion data, the convolutional layers and pooling layers in the ResNet architecture are replaced by the fully connected layers, and an improved ResNet model is constructed. Finally, the tool’s wear condition is identified with the improved ResNet model. Experiments have shown that the model has a high ability to identify and classify the three different states of tool initial wear, normal wear and severe wear, and can achieve an identification and classification accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 5 \%}$.

articleTitle: A Novel Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Under Signal Loss Based on LSTM Feature Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In bearing fault diagnosis, sensor signal acquisition can suffer severe data loss due to hardware failures or external interference, making it challenging for traditional methods to effectively handle such incomplete data. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel bearing fault diagnosis method under signal loss based on Long Short-Term Memory network Feature Compensation (LSTM_FC). First, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is utilized to extract deep features from bearing signals. Subsequently, LSTM is applied to compensate for the missing features, generating a complete feature representation. Finally, Global Average Pooling (GAP) and fully connected layers are used to perform the classification task. The proposed method is validated on the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) bearing dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that even with 60% signal loss, the method achieves a classification accuracy exceeding 80%, showcasing its strong robustness and potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: A deep learning-based optimization strategy for small object detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In high-altitude images captured by UAVs, small targets often appear densely packed, occupy fewer pixels, and suffer from mutual occlusion, making accurate detection a significant challenge. To address this issue, this paper proposes an optimization strategy based on YOLOv5s. First, the DHDCNv4 detection head is introduced to enhance the feature detection capability across different scales of the corresponding feature layers by incorporating unified attention mechanisms. Second, to reduce the sensitivity of IOU to small target displacement, the NWD loss function is employed as a replacement for the traditional IOU. Finally, the proposed approach is evaluated on the Visdrone2019 dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the original YOLOv5s in detecting small targets in high-altitude UAV imagery.

articleTitle: Robot Welding Posture Optimization Method Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: When robots are welding workpieces with complex seams, such as corrugated plates, there may be significant changes in the welding gun posture, leading to excessive acceleration of the robot’s joint movements. This can cause severe shaking of the robot end effector, affecting the welding quality and even resulting in the robot’s overload emergency stop, thereby reducing processing efficiency. The welding gun posture can be adjusted in terms of working angle and travel angle, providing ample space for optimizing the robot processing performance. Therefore, this paper proposes a posture optimization method based on genetic algorithms. By using genetic algorithms to determine the optimal welding posture, the goal is to minimize the acceleration of the robot joint movements and achieve the smoothest welding trajectory.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Domain Adaption of Multimodal Traffic Scenes Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation based on Self-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Unsupervised domain-adaptive (UDA) semantic segmentation of 3D LiDAR point clouds in multimodal traffic scenes faces challenges in segmenting small objects like pedestrians and cyclists, with cross-modal learning often leading to misleading results. To address this problem, the paper proposes TransUDA, a multi-modal point cloud semantic segmentation network based on transformers and multi-scale information fusion. The model improves segmentation of small objects by leveraging an effective receptive field. Additionally, a cross-modal learning mechanism with entropy adaptive weight redistribution ensures proper guidance of inter-modal information. Results show that TransUDA achieves a 2.7% mIoU improvement in Nuscenes (USA-Singapore) and 1.38% mIoU in DayNight, with 3.5% IoU improvement for pedestrians and 7.89 % IoU improvement for cyclists.

articleTitle: A Strategic Study of (Anhui Province) Opera Non-Heritage in Dynamic Graphics Based on Interaction Design and Virtual Imaging Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning and artificial intelligence technologies play an important role in virtual imaging. Through neural networks and deep learning algorithms, more accurate and efficient virtual imaging generation can be realized to enhance the realism and fidelity of virtual environments. The state’s emphasis on intangible cultural heritage has promoted the protection and development of the art of opera. The core objective of this study is to innovatively present the artistic expression of Anhui Province’s opera-based non-heritage through interactive design and virtual imaging technology. By designing interactive and immersive digital experiences, we enhance the attractiveness and dissemination of the opera culture, and promote the inheritance and innovation of the non-heritage culture in the modern society. This paper analyzes and researches the dynamic graphics of opera in depth based on the big data algorithm of interaction design. Combining modern technology and traditional algorithms, the heritage of non-heritage and modern big data hotspots are combined and integrated research and analysis. Anhui Province as a key region of the cultural heritage of opera, the inheritance of culture more should get better technical support, which is also the great significance of this paper to carry out integration research.

articleTitle: Intelligent Early Warning Algorithm for Abnormal Work Orders of Key Nodes Based on Frequent Itemsets
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In order to accurately analyze the abnormal data of work orders and give an early warning, and improve the management level of work orders, an intelligent early warning algorithm of work orders in key nodes based on frequent itemsets is proposed. Under frequent itemsets, the support and confidence are analyzed to realize direct mining of frequent itemsets, and the association rule reconstruction function of candidate itemsets is constructed. Based on the association rule reconstruction function, the abnormal characteristics of key node work orders are determined. Calculate the similarity between real-time features and abnormal features of data, and based on this, extract key node work orders; Determine the early warning level of key node work orders from two aspects: severity and urgency. The normalized target value is solved, the weight is updated, and the confidence anomaly coefficient is set according to the work order business requirements of key nodes, so as to obtain the early warning result of work order anomaly of key nodes. The experimental results show that this algorithm can accurately identify and warn the abnormal work orders of key nodes, with high accuracy and reliability, and send out early warning information in time to remind staff to deal with the abnormal work orders of key nodes in time.

articleTitle: Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization Agorithm for Maximum Power Point Tracking of Vertical Sxis Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This paper investigates the optimization problem of a vertical axis wind turbine (VAWT) energy system aiming to maximise the output power of a permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) based system. To this end, a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) method based on rotational speed control is proposed and combined with an adaptive particle swarm optimization (APSO) algorithm to optimally regulate the rotational speed. Simulation results show that the wind turbine with this method can effectively operate at the maximum power point and achieve the speed regulation and output power optimization under wind speed variation.

articleTitle: Design of a Text Recognition System Based on Jetson Nano
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In laboratory environments with high confidentiality requirements, traditional manual data recording methods are inefficient and prone to errors. To address this challenge, this paper proposes an offline text recognition platform based on the Jetson Nano. The platform uses embedded devices for text recognition, supporting batch image uploads from terminal devices and providing fast recognition results. The core algorithm uses PaddleOCR, and the model is optimized and pruned through Paddle Lite to fit the computational and memory limitations of the Jetson Nano. Additionally, the platform leverages GPU acceleration to perform parallel image preprocessing, significantly improving processing efficiency. Experimental results show that, when applied to the Jiangmen neutrino experiment, the platform processes on-site instrument data images at a speed of 1 seconds per image with a recognition accuracy of ${9 4. 5 \%}$, and supports simultaneous upload requests from four terminal devices. The platform not only improves data collection efficiency but also ensures data security, making it suitable for text recognition needs in high-security environments.

articleTitle: Design of a Digital Twin System for Substations Based on Unity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: A digital twin system for substations, grounded in digital twin technology and developed using Unity, is presented in this paper. This system facilitates the monitoring, management, and analysis of substations. A mapping is established between the physical equipment and virtual models within the system to mirror the operational status of the substation, thereby assisting operations and maintenance personnel in the rapid identification of potential issues. The capabilities of the system encompass scene browsing, equipment display, simulated equipment repair, and data application. Operational data is collected from substation sensors, and Unity’s graphical rendering capabilities are harnessed to craft an intuitive 3D interface. This interface empowers users to gain a comprehensive understanding of the substation’s operational status. Furthermore, the system integrates Python for the analysis of historical data, enabling the provision of fault detection and maintenance recommendations. This integration serves to enhance equipment reliability and operational efficiency. Utilizing this digital twin system, intelligent monitoring and data-driven decision-making are achieved, leading to the optimization of operational management and the enhancement of overall operational benefits.

articleTitle: External Knowledge Is Not Always Needed: An Adaptive Retrieval Augmented Generation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG), by integrating external knowledge with large language models (LLMs), has become a common practice to alleviate LLMs’ hallucination problem. The performance of RAG, however, depends on the capability of the adopted information retriever to a large extent. Specifically, a good information retriever can manage to obtain the most useful information from the external knowledge, which will then enhance the quality of generated content from LLMs and vice versa. Since the vanilla RAG will always leverage the retrieved information to assist with LLMs’ content generation despite of its usefulness, when combined with a retriever of limited capacity, therefore, the vanilla RAG will not benefit LLMs’ content generation sometimes but introduce additional noise, having a negative impact on the final performance. To address this problem, this paper proposes a novel adaptive RAG method which first uses LLMs to determine the usefulness of the retrieved information and then let LLMs to generate content on their own without the retrieved information if it is useless. Experimental results on four datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive RAG method with information retrievers of various capabilities, improving the performance of the vanilla RAG by an obvious margin.

articleTitle: Cross-domain Sentiment Classification with Prompt Pre-training and Tuning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Sentiment classification, as an essential task for understanding the sentiment content of texts, has garnered extensive attention. However, existing methods face numerous challenges, such as the mismatch between training and testing data in specific domains, which results in insufficient adaptability of models to new domains. Prompt learning is a parameter-efficient strategy that effectively enables pre-trained models to adapt to downstream tasks. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage method called PT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which consists of two key components: prompt pre-training and prompt fine-tuning. During the prompt pre-training phase, we employ masked language modeling and cross-domain prompt learning, aiming to uncover latent sentiments and acquire cross-domain knowledge. In the prompt fine-tuning phase, we apply the pre-trained model to specific cross-domain sentiment classification tasks, adjusting the model parameters through additional sentiment prompt templates to improve its performance on these specific tasks. We conducted experiments on publicly available datasets and established nine different cross-domain settings. The results indicate that the model, employing our proposed $\mathrm{PT}^{2}$, significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches in cross-domain sentiment classification tasks.

articleTitle: Control Method for Capturing a Moving Object by an Operational Flying Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In this paper, an operational flying robot control method is investigated. For the operational flying robot tracking error dynamics and kinematics equations, actuator faults are considered while the control objective is set; regulation function, decreasing function and bounding function are introduced to design an estimation-free fault-tolerant controller to realize the grasping function of the moving object.

articleTitle: Research on Environmental Perception Technology for Intelligent Robots Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Addressing the issue of insufficient environmental perception capabilities during the movement of intelligent robots, this paper puts forth a technology for environmental perception of intelligent robots based on machine vision. The approach commences by capturing environmental images using cameras mounted on the robot, followed by processing and analyzing the collected data for path planning. Through the construction of a robotic platform and field environmental testing, the results demonstrate that the proposed method exhibits high accuracy and reliability in perceiving the surrounding environment, showcasing significant innovation and practicality.

articleTitle: Weighted Strategy Optimization Approach for Discrete Sequence Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) perform well in continuous data generation, but face challenges in discrete sequence generation due to the non-differentiability of backpropagation. SeqGAN addresses this issue by utilizing the policy gradient method; however, it still suffers from limitations such as low efficiency, inadequate reward utilization, and a tendency to converge to local optima. This paper proposes a discrete sequence generation model, W-SeqGAN, which is based on Weighted Policy Optimization (WPO). This model incorporates WPO into the training process of the generator. Its dynamic weighting mechanism ena bles the generator to focus on samples with strong discriminator feedback or those that are difficult to generate, thereby enhancing the generation quality. Experiments were conducted using synthe tic data, and the Negative Log Likelihood (NLL) was adopted as t he evaluation metric. The results indicate that W-SeqGAN outper forms traditional SeqGAN and other baseline models in terms of generation quality and training efficiency.

articleTitle: An Optimized Intrusion Detection Scheme for Industrial Control Systems in IIOT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: As the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) expands, security vulnerabilities in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) have escalated, challenging traditional Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). This study introduces FiPCAi, a new feature selection method combining Fisher-Score, Incremental PCA, and ChatGPT, to enhance IDS efficiency in multi-source IIoT environments. We also present the CMA-BiLSTM model, which integrates CNN with a multi-head attention mechanism in a BiLSTM framework, demonstrating superior detection capabilities on datasets such as CIC-IDS2017 and CSE-CIC-IDS2018, with noted accuracies above 98%. A DANN-based transfer learning experiment on the WUSTL-IIOT-2021 dataset further confirmed the model’s robust generalization, achieving $\mathbf{9 8. 6 \%}$ accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Functional Aggregation Strategy for Multi-Source Heterogeneous Data of Vehicle-Network Interaction Considering Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In order to realize vehicle to grid (V2G) network data aggregation with fault tolerance and multiple aggregation functions, this paper proposes a multi-source heterogeneous data aggregation strategy for vehicle-network interaction considering privacy protection. Firstly, a privacy-preserving data aggregation scheme is designed for V2G networks by integrating fully homomorphic encryption and secret sharing technology. Secondly, the fog calculation is introduced to unload the calculation pressure of the control center. It greatly reduces the computational overhead of the control center in the process of V2G network data aggregation. Then, the alliance chain is introduced to solve the dependence problem on trusted third parties, and the storage structure of transactions and blocks is adjusted to reduce communication and storage overhead. Finally, security analysis shows that the proposed method reduces the computational overhead of the control center by 64.3%, and reduces the total communication overhead of the charging pile and the system by 23.4% and 17.2%, respectively.

articleTitle: License plate detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The issues of challenging license plate localization, sluggish detection, and low accuracy in challenging situations including low resolution, multi-vehicle traffic, and lighting are addressed by a proposed technique to enhance YOLOv8. Three improvements are made to the suggested approach based on the YOLOv8 framework. The license plate’s shape and contour features can be more precisely and effectively recorded by using AKConv in the model’s neck network, which automatically modifies the convolution kernel’s shape based on the object’s size and shape; Second, the SA attention mechanism is added to the C2f module, which betters the accuracy and performance of the system by drawing attention to the license plate’s features from two dimensions. Third, we use SPPE_EMA rather than the conventional SPPF in order to increase prediction accuracy. With these enhancements, the model can more effectively extract features from license plate images, increasing the identification accuracy. Results from experiments on the public dataset CCPD demonstrate that the enhanced Yolov8 performs noticeably better than the original Yolov8. Specifically, assuming that the model’s number of parameters has been decreased by $\mathbf{1 2 \%}$, the precision has increased by 0.9%, and the map50-95 has improved by 2.6%, respectively, our method offers an efficient number plate detection solution.

articleTitle: Mesh Simplification Method Based on Fast Retrieval and Region-Preserving Quadric Error Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This article explores an optimization method for lightweight 3D models by implementing mesh simplification through the Enhanced Quadratic Error Metric (QEM) algorithm. In response to the common problems of feature loss and geometric structure anomalies in the QEM algorithm, this study introduces surface density, vertex curvature, vertex distance, and boundary folding cost as simplification factors. These factors precisely control the folding cost of the edges, effectively preserving model features and maintaining the integrity of the geometric structure. In addition, the principle of KD tree is utilized to accelerate the search for effective point pairs, thereby reducing the complexity of the algorithm and improving processing efficiency. Experimental verification shows that the proposed improved QEM algorithm not only maintains high detail features, but also reduces the Hausdorff distance by at least $\mathbf{8 4. 9 5 \%}$ compared to the original QEM algorithm. Therefore, this algorithm provides a more efficient and reliable solution for lightweight 3D models.

articleTitle: An interactive procedural modeling method for buildings based on template matching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer graphics technology, procedural modeling is a method to efficiently generate virtual 3D models, and complex geometric models are generated through certain algorithm rules. Traditional procedural modeling techniques have a high degree of automation, but the rule design is cumbersome, and it is difficult to adapt to different styles or highly customized architectural needs, and the flexibility and editability are limited. In this paper, a procedural generation method of urban building single model based on template matching algorithm is proposed, which introduces CGA (Computer Generated Architecture) shape grammar to guide the layout generation of building facade structure. The creation process of the model is to create a freeform white mold as the building basic model, then create the building facade with the custom constraint layout of the subsidiary structure, and finally combine the white mold and the facade structure through the template matching algorithm proposed in this paper. The entire creation process is parametrically controlled, mapping from the building layer to the building parameters, and by adjusting the parameters, it is possible to generate a 3D building model that meets the needs and has a variety of appearances and is realistic. Experimental results show that this method can realize rapid building modeling and significantly improve the modeling efficiency.

articleTitle: Long Dialogue Segmentation Based on Memory Similarity Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In the digital era, with the widespread use of the internet and accelerated digitalization, the speed of information generation and dissemination has significantly increased, leading to the challenge of information overload with massive data and lengthy texts. This paper proposes a BiLSTM-based similarity calculation model designed to achieve automatic segmentation of long dialogues while maintaining semantic similarity in the segmented text. We conducted a series of experiments on the DialSeg711 and Doc2Dial datasets and compared our model with various state-of-the-art dialogue segmentation models, including BayesSeg, GraphSeg, TextTiling, and its improved versions: TextTiling + Glove and TextTiling + Embedding. Using Pk and WD as primary evaluation metrics, we systematically assessed the performance of the proposed model in terms of topic consistency and segmentation accuracy. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed BiLSTM-COS method shows significant advantages in the task of topic segmentation in long dialogues, effectively capturing contextual information within conversations and substantially improving semantic consistency and segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Lightweight YOLOv8 Pedestrian Detection Model Based on FasterNet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: To address the challenges posed by the computational complexity of the YOLOv8 detection head, which limits its applicability on common surveillance devices and intelligent processing terminals, as well as the low accuracy and poor robustness of existing detection models in occlusion tasks, a lightweight pedestrian detection model based on an improved YOLOv8 was proposed. The backbone network was integrated with the FasterNet network, which requires less computational power and memory. Furthermore, a novel object detection head based on group normalization was introduced to reduce computational costs by reusing feature information in object detection tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves superior lightweight performance compared to the original YOLOv8n model. Specifically, the number of parameters was reduced by $\mathbf{4 5 \%}$, the computational cost was decreased by 39%, and the model size was reduced by 41%, with only a 0.1% decrease in detection accuracy. These results highlight the practicality and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Neural Network Based on Optimized Variational Mode Decomposition Denoising for Wind Turbine Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The health of the wind turbine bearing has a decisive impact on the continuity and safety of wind power generation. However, diagnosing faults in rolling bearings presents challenges due to their complex operational environment and the non-linear characteristics of the original vibration data generated. To address this issue, this paper proposes a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method, based on optimized Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) combined with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)Transformer architecture. First, by optimizing the parameters of VMD, WOA effectively solves the defects of VMD in parameter selection and decomposition accuracy, decomposes the key information modes in the signal more accurately, and improves the quality of feature extraction, which significantly improves the overall performance and accuracy of fault diagnosis. A CNN-transformer fusion model is proposed for existing fault diagnosis algorithms that suffer from defects such as incomplete feature extraction, insufficient dynamic feature capture, and limited generalization capability. Leveraging the hybrid model to fully explore and utilize the complex patterns and dynamic characteristics within the vibration data for precise identification of wind turbine bearing fault conditions. Finally, experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method in wind turbine rolling bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Sugarcane Pest and Disease Monitoring System Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: As agriculture continues to develop, the cultivation area of sugarcane has been expanding steadily. Traditional agricultural management techniques are facing limitations such as restricted manual inspection range, high time consumption, low accuracy in pest and disease identification, crude control methods, and heavy labor intensity. This study aims to monitor sugarcane pests and diseases using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) remote sensing. By collecting precise information during periods when sugarcane is highly susceptible to pests and diseases, and employing neural networks for real-time diagnosis, we aim to facilitate sugarcane farmers in accurately identifying and controlling pests and diseases. This will mitigate the harm caused by pests and diseases, leading to increased sugarcane yield and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning Method Based on Improved A* Algorithm and Robot Operating System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: As mobile robot technology advances, path planning emerges as a crucial research area. This paper introduces an improved $A^{*}$ algorithm to optimize path planning, addressing the A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm’s limitations like excessive node expansion, prolonged computation time, and frequent path turning angles, while ensuring safety, efficiency, and stability. The proposed algorithm enhances the $A^{*}$ algorithm’s node expansion by selecting search nodes according to obstacle positions. Then, the heuristic function is dynamically weighted to enhance the search efficiency of the algorithm. Finally, the path is optimized using cubic Bézier curves to ensure smoothness. Experiments in ROS confirm that the proposed algorithm performs well and is suitable as path planning algorithm for mobile robots.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Reasoning and Security Assurance Decision-Making Based on Online Retrieval Augment Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: The Sino-Russian pipeline network, a critical infrastructure for energy supply, faces multifaceted risks ranging from geopolitical instability and international sanctions to sophisticated cyber threats. This paper proposes a novel framework leveraging Knowledge Graph (KG) reasoning and online Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to enhance security assurance and risk prevention decision-making for this vital energy corridor. Our approach integrates a dynamically updated KG with large language models (LLMs) to facilitate real-time risk assessment, scenario planning, and proactive mitigation strategies. We detail the methodology for KG construction, LLM integration, and RAG implementation, and demonstrate its efficacy through simulated experiments. Our results indicate that this framework significantly improves the accuracy and timeliness of risk identification and response, offering a robust solution for safeguarding critical energy infrastructure.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition of Geometric Tolerance Symbol Annotation Blocks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In previous mechanical design drawings, the geometric tolerance symbol annotation block was directly annotated on the mechanical design drawing by engineers, resulting in the symbol annotation block being non-editable and non-shareable. To achieve digitization, this study proposes an improved Swin_YOLOv5_GE model based on YOLOv5 to realize the positioning of the symbol annotation block. Compared with the original YOLOv5, the accuracy is increased by 4%. Then, image processing is performed on the located and cropped symbol annotation block to achieve denoising and tilt correction of the symbol annotation block. Finally, it is input into CRNN for the recognition of the symbol annotation block. The final experimental results prove that the method in this paper can obtain an overall recognition accuracy of 94%, proving the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: A Real-time Detection Embedded Edge Computing System Based on SNN-ONNX Model Deployment Inference
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: With the development of neural network technology, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown great potential in edge computing and embedded systems due to their biologically inspired and low-power characteristics. This paper proposes an optimization method based on a custom LIF neuron model to solve the problem of operator conflicts that arise during the conversion of trained SNNs models to ONNX format. By replacing the official LIF neuron model with a custom LIF neuron and achieving cross-framework deployment after model conversion, the method was successfully applied to an embedded system for real-time image classification tasks, meeting the real-time detection requirements in edge computing environments. This method not only completes the hardware implementation of the SNNs model, but also significantly improves its portability and interoperability in embedded systems.

articleTitle: A new paradigm for Light-addressable potentiometric sensor detection based on Gaussian fitting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Light-addressable potentiometric sensor (LAPS) is a low-cost and versatile semiconductor field-effect pH sensor. The measurement of pH by traditional LPAS usually adopts the way of normalizing the V-I characteristic curve, which needs to obtain the data of the whole V-I characteristic curve, resulting in slow measurement speed and long time. To address this problem, a new $\mathbf{p H}$ measurement method is proposed in this paper, which integrally considers the nonlinear error in the linear region by fitting a Gaussian function to the local linear region of the V-I characteristic curve, and the measurement results are directly obtained from the parameters of the fitted function. The experimental results show that the sensitivity and repetition rate of the new detection method can be comparable with that of the V I characteristic curve measurement method, and the linearity is improved by 0.81%, which helps to improve the measurement efficiency and realize the rapid measurement of pH.

articleTitle: Lightweight Design of Image Denoising based on TNet mini
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Image denoising is vital in fields like autonomous driving and medical imaging to reduce noise while preserving quality. Traditional methods blur edges, and deep learning is computationally costly. This paper proposes TNet mini, a convolutional neural network based on denoising algorithm that balances denoising performance and efficiency. The algorithm introduces a network model that can be adapted to different application scenarios by selecting models of varying sizes. After training, the model is quantized from 32-bit to 8-bit, reducing storage requirements by 73% with only a slight decrease in denoising quality (PSNR drops by 0.215). The algorithm outperforms typical deep learning models in both performance and speed, making it suitable for deployment on edge devices. To address the high power consumption issues of commonly used convolutional neural network inference hardware, this paper designs a dedicated hardware accelerator for TNet mini network inference. The accelerator achieves 38.5135 GOPS/W energy efficiency, outperforming both the 2080Ti GPU (7.1429 GOPS/W) and i5-12400f CPU (2.5281 GOPS/W), offering up to 15.23 times better efficiency than the i5-12400f and 5.39 times better than the 2080Ti.

articleTitle: Automatic Chart Decoding System Based on Deep Learning and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Statistical Charts contain a wealth of information. As an important way to visualize data presentation, statistical charts allow viewers to obtain a complete and intuitive understanding of the content shown in a very short time. At present, the research on automatic extraction and understanding of a large amount of text information has been relatively mature. However, even the latest big artificial intelligence models cannot accurately extract statistical graphs, which are personalized and contain a large amount of information. We propose an automatic bar chart data extraction process by combining deep learning and image processing technology, and construct an intelligent bar chart decoding system. The system is divided into three parts: the classification of statistical chart types, the text detection in the image, the classification of text roles and the image extraction. The original data used to create the chart in the pan-bar graph image is extracted for downstream applications. We evaluate and compare our system on public datasets. The results show that our system has better accuracy.

articleTitle: The underwater acoustic recognition network based on dynamic attention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative underwater acoustic target recognition network framework, BiTransKan, which integrates Dynamic Sparse Attention (BiFormer), a Dual Dynamic Mixing Module (D-Mixer), and interpretable Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), significantly improving recognition efficiency and accuracy in complex underwater acoustic environments. Experimental results based on the DeepShip dataset show that the proposed model outperforms existing methods in terms of accuracy, computational efficiency, and model interpretability, providing a new technical solution and development direction for future research and practical applications in underwater acoustic target recognition.

articleTitle: Research and application of digital twin technology in smart city
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Digital twin is a forward-looking notion in digital governance and the development direction of smart cities. Digital twin technology, as a novel technological means, offers favorable support for decision-making and prediction in smart city construction by simulating real-world information. This paper commences from the concept formation of digital twin smart cities, elaborates on the research and application of its technology based on practical practices, and provides application strategies in traffic management, energy systems, environmental protection detection, and public safety. This approach can achieve real-time monitoring and optimization of urban operational status, promote intelligent and efficient urban management, and offer a new concept for the development and construction of smart cities.

articleTitle: An Orchard Dense Map Construction Method Based on Improved ORB-SLAM3
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: To solve the problem of small number of image feature points matching, feature points loss and sparse point cloud caused by the complex lighting conditions in the orchard environment in hilly and mountain. An improved ORB-SLAM3 orchard dense map construction method was proposed in this paper. This method proposes an adaptive threshold FAST corner extraction method to the tracking thread of ORB-SLAM3. According to the average pixel of the current image under different illumination, the corresponding threshold is solved, which increases the number of feature points extracted under different conditions and improves the robustness of the method. Then, the line feature extraction method is added to the tracking thread, and the point-line fusion feature tracking is carried out to enrich the feature information in the environment. Finally, on the basis of the original method, a dense mapping thread is added to construct a three-dimensional dense map of the orchard, which solves the problem of sparse point cloud information in the original method. The experimental result shows that, compared with the original ORB-SLAM3, the average matching number of feature points in this method increases by $12.67 \%, 14.61 \%$ and 31.36 % under normal illumination, weak illumination and rainy weather. The method proposed in this paper has richer point cloud information and greatly restores scene information, which can provide support for orchard robot navigation path planning.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Path Planning Method for Collaborative Robotic Arm Based on Improved APF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Dynamic obstacle avoidance path planning is the basic key technology to ensure the safety of tightly coupled human-robot collaboration. In order to solve the problems of human obstacle envelope space abnormality, large mutation of motion trajectory and high uncertainty in the closely coupled human-robot collaboration scenario, an improved artificial potential field method was proposed and a dynamic obstacle avoidance experiment of the cooperative robotic arm was carried out. The results show that the improved artificial potential field method effectively solves the problems existing in the traditional artificial potential field method, can successfully reach the target point in complex environments, and can effectively support the continuous and safe operation of the robotic arm in the scenario of tight coupling human-robot collaboration.

articleTitle: Maritime Small Object Detection in UAV Images based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: As countries around the world emphasize and develop marine resources, the frequency of maritime accidents is increasing year by year. However, most of the current object detection algorithms are unable to accomplish both high detection accuracy and smaller parameter sizes in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) images for small objects. To improve the accuracy of small object detection, the backbone network incorporating the attention mechanism is proposed and the original spatial pyramid pooling (SPP) structure is improved to enhance the ability of the model to extract object features. The single detection head in the YOLOv5 model is replaced by a decoupled detection head to improve the accuracy and robustness of the detection. In addition, to reduce the parameters of the model, the neck network of the original model is also lightened and improved in this paper. Based on the above improvements, the SCD-YOLO algorithm is proposed in this paper, which is specialized for small object detection algorithm in maritime environments in UAV images. Finally, the improved algorithm is thoroughly analyzed and evaluated in this paper on self-made marine datasets. The ablation experiments and comparative experiments show that the detection performance of the SCD-YOLO algorithm is significantly improved, and the value of mAP is increased from 87.2% to 91.0%.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Path Planning Algorithm for Filter Plate Cleaning of Plate and Frame Filter Press
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Plate and frame filter press is an important solid-liquid separation equipment that plays an important role in many fields. The filter plate is one of the core components of the frame filter press, and its main function is to support the filter cloth and form a filter chamber. After the filtration process of the filter press is completed, a large number of impurities are often attached to the filter plate, so it is of great value to study the impurity cleaning problem of the filter plate of the plate and frame filter press. In this paper, aiming at the cleaning process of the filter plate of the plate and frame filter press, the image information of the filter plate is obtained by visual means, and then the image is analyzed and processed to obtain the position information of the impurities of the filter plate, the path planning of the obtained position information is carried out, and finally the robot is made to complete the cleaning task efficiently and accurately according to the planned path, which has certain practical value.

articleTitle: A robotic arm RRT* path planning algorithm based on adaptive target point sampling and path smoothing optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Path planning is essential for robotic arms to perform tasks in complex environments, where efficiency, feasibility, and path quality are critical. This paper proposes an improved RRT* (Rapidly-exploring Random Tree Star) algorithm to address the slow convergence and poor path quality of traditional RRT*. An adaptive target sampling strategy dynamically adjusts the sampling probability, balancing global exploration and local convergence. Path optimization combines neighborhood search, optimal parent selection, and rewiring to reduce costs and improve quality. Quintic B-spline interpolation ensures smooth, continuous paths. The algorithm integrates inverse kinematics and joint space validity checks to meet kinematic constraints and practical execution. Simulations with a six-DOF robotic arm show the improved RRT* outperforms the traditional algorithm in path length, smoothness, and efficiency, especially in complex environments. This approach offers an effective solution for robotic arm planning in industrial automation, medical robotics, and similar fields.

articleTitle: Research on motion planning of 6-DOF manipulator based on optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: This study focuses on the motion planning of a 6DOF robot arm in complex task scenarios, and deeply explores the key issues such as kinematic modeling, joint Angle path optimization, energy consumption minimization, and obstacle avoidance. By constructing the inverse kinematics model, using particle swarm optimization algorithm, combining mixed integer linear programming and A * algorithm, multi-objective genetic algorithm and hierarchical optimization strategy, the efficient motion planning of robot arm under different task requirements is realized. The research results show that the proposed model and algorithm significantly improve the performance and energy efficiency of the robot arm, which provides strong support for its wide application in industrial automation and other fields.

Author Keywords: Six degrees of freedom robot arm

articleTitle: Advancing Abstract Reasoning in Artificial General Intelligence with a Hybrid Multi-Component Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) models face significant challenges in abstract reasoning tasks, which require deep understanding and generalization across a wide range of domains. This study introduces a novel hybrid multicomponent architecture designed to enhance AGI performance on abstract reasoning tasks. The proposed model integrates advanced techniques including Transformer-based self-attention mechanisms, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), and Reinforcement Learning (RL). Each component addresses distinct aspects of the task: Transformers capture sequence dependencies, GNNs model complex relationships between entities, GANs generate realistic data for training, and RL optimizes reasoning strategies. The synergy of these components allows the model to achieve strong generalization and abstract learning capabilities, significantly improving performance compared to single-component models. The experimental results on the ARC-AGI benchmark demonstrate the superiority of this hybrid approach, with marked improvements in key performance metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, mean squared error (MSE), and AUC-ROC. These results confirm that the proposed model is a promising solution to overcoming the limitations of current AGI systems in tackling novel and complex reasoning tasks. Future work will focus on further optimization of the model components, expanding its scope to more complex tasks, and evaluating its performance in practical applications such as natural language understanding and robotics.

articleTitle: Efficient Resource Management in IoV through Task Offloading Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: With advancements in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) and wireless technologies, intelligent vehicles are becoming increasingly prevalent, introducing applications that are computationally intensive, energy-consuming, and highly sensitive to latency. However, the limited computational capabilities of vehicles often result in excessive workloads that exceed local processing capacity, undermining real-time performance. VEC addresses this challenge by deploying computational resources at the network edge, particularly in Roadside Units (RSUs). In the field of task offloading for the IoV, recent studies have demonstrated the potential of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in addressing task offloading challenges, particularly in reducing latency and energy consumption. However, research on effectively utilizing computational resources within the IoV to further optimize latency and energy efficiency remains relatively limited, making it a promising area for future exploration. In this context, we propose a reinforcement learning-based optimization algorithm, PPOH, to enhance resource utilization and performance in the IoV environments. The algorithm optimizes the transmission power between vehicles and RSU, vehicle CPU frequencies, and RSU resource allocation ratios, balancing energy consumption and latency. Simulation results validate the convergence of PPOH, demonstrating its superior performance compared to benchmark algorithms across key metrics.

articleTitle: Resampling Consensus Constrainted by Local Structure Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: At present, the matching method based on local graph structure has become a popular method for image matching and mismatch elimination and can achieve good results in many scenes. However, in some scenes with numerous repeated structures, the effect of the matching method based on local graph structure will be greatly reduced. Therefore, this paper proposes a method of eliminating mismatching based on local graph structure similarity combined with resampling to obtain the optimal sampling model. The method firstly obtains the initial matching point pairs based on SIFT and KNN, and then obtains K nearest neighbor nodes of each feature point, and then calculates the local nearest neighbor structural similarity score of each pair of feature matching points. Finally, the optimal transformation matrix model is calculated based on some matching points with the highest similarity score, and the mismatching is detected and removed by the optimal transformation matrix. The experimental results on the dataset Hpatches show that compared with the LGSC algorithm, the precision is increased by more than 7% on average, and the F -value is increased by 3% on average.

articleTitle: Design of a Real time Monitoring System for Production Workshops with Multi maturity Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In recent years, with the advent of the Industry 4.0 era and the rapid development of network and information technology, there has been an urgent need for effective supervision and accurate analysis of the workshop production process. The emergence of digital twin technology provides new technical means for the effective supervision of production workshops. At present, there are inconsistent definition standards for digital twins in the workshop manufacturing process at home and abroad, many technical bottlenecks and lack of theoretical support. Therefore, this study proposes an efficient and reliable digital twin real-time monitoring method based on the demand for real-time monitoring in manufacturing workshops, providing theoretical support for intelligent perception and control in workshops.

articleTitle: Short-Term Surface Wind Field Forecasting at Multiple Stations Based on MSTFRDGC-BOBiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: Wind field forecasting is crucial in meteorology, impacting aviation safety, wind power generation, and weather warnings. Wind field variations are complex, influenced by various meteorological factors, and historical data are often incomplete, increasing the difficulty of prediction. In response, we propose a novel model integrating a Multivariable Spatiotemporal Graph Convolutional Network and a Bayesian Optimization Bidirectional Long-Short-Term Memory Network, termed MSTFRDGC-BO-BiLSTM, for short-term wind field forecasting. This model employs an interpolation attention mechanism and adaptive graph convolutional networks to extract spatial features and handle data missingness, while utilizing a Bayesian-optimized BiLSTM to precisely model temporal sequence changes. Experiments demonstrate that the model is significantly effective in wind field forecasting and has practical application value.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Convolutional Dual-Channel Transformer Framework for Efficient Part Segmentation of Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Manufacturing (AIIM)
abstract: In recent years, transformer-based models have made significant breakthroughs in natural language processing and computer vision. However, these models have encountered challenges when dealing with point cloud data because the irregular and disordered structure of point cloud data leads to a huge computational and memory burden.
